title: Tom at the Market
text:
Tom goes to the market on Monday. He wants apples, rice, and a big fish. The market is busy and loud. He has ten dollars in his pocket.

Tom asks the seller for the price. The fish costs eight dollars. He buys the fish and two apples. Then he goes home to cook dinner.

questions.text: What does Tom want to buy?
options: Apples, rice, and a big fish

questions.text: How much does the fish cost?
What can we infer about the market?
options: It is a popular place with many people

questions.text: Why might Tom be happy at the end of the story?
options: He found the fish he wanted for dinner
He lost his money at the market
He had no food for dinner
He did not like the fish

vocabulary.definition: a place where people buy and sell food and other goods
the amount of money you must pay for something

paragraph_translations: Tom vai ao mercado na segunda-feira. Ele quer maçãs, arroz e um peixe grande. O mercado está movimentado e barulhento. Ele tem dez dólares no bolso.
Tom pergunta ao vendedor o preço. O peixe custa oito dólares. Ele compra o peixe e duas maçãs. Depois ele vai para casa cozinhar o jantar.
